note: e31 cause is 'cutting and steam' (read as separate treatments incl. cutting). Vegetation suppression edges (e18,e23,e28,e29,e48) excluded: method not stated as mechanical; scarification/clear-cut/overstory removal are neighbouring classes. Species-level abundance, richness and diversity edges are not composition.
Candidates are soil nitrogen addition and water chemistry, not CO2 or air chemistry; nothing relevant.

e44 (end of backcross stocking -> no angler catches) excluded: angler catch is not plainly fish numbers. Including it as +1 would give 'increase'. Owl, elk and fox releases are excluded because their outcomes are not fish.
Pond construction/enhancement (e3,e5,e7) treated as wetland creation; excluding it leaves the result unchanged (mixed, very_low).
Planted grass and Agropyron cristatum cover counted as competing vegetation. Deciduous tree cover (e11) excluded as canopy; e60 is reversed; diversity-only outcomes excluded.
Signed by the node as worded (higher light -> more species). e21 (deciduous tree cover -> lower richness) excluded: not plainly canopy shade. Cirsium seedling counts are not species counts.

Only outcomes stated as native count; single-species covers that the text does not mark as native (Aldermac, Sphagnum, wetland species) are excluded. Active-vs-passive restoration edges are variant contrasts. Specific methods (seeding, herbicide, smoke, ash, mowing) belong to narrower classes.
No bird outcomes among candidates; dredging edges concern amphibians.

Soil inoculum treated as an amendment (more vs less). Excluded: acrotelm application (donor-layer transfer), Thuja 'establishment success' (e47, not plainly survival), grass/forb and Carex survival (not plainly seedlings or trees), provenance and sterilization contrasts.
Mulch edges report only soil N, moisture, temperature or plant biomass; the microbial edges come from cover soils, not mulch.
